services.name: Go Sailing
services.desc: 'Gaviota' is a beautiful, comfortable, and safe sailing vessel, perfect for enjoying a few hours out in Socal waters. A modern 'Oceanis 37" built by Beneteau, she is lovingly cared for and in tip top condition. With safety being the number one priority, she is maintained and equipped beyond required

blurb: WIND + WATER offers intimate, customizable sailing charters on their yacht based out of Oceanside Harbor. Trips are led by a friendly local USCG licensed Captain and tailored to guests' pace, interests, and occasion. Guests can enjoy views of the North County coastline, migrating Gray Whales (December through April), and Common Dolphins year-round.
